title: Model answer
description: Body of a `report` artifact holding one API or local model Worker's answer (design/models.md). The prompt is referenced by hash only; the model is named by its catalog id. 1.1 (T209) allows `attempts` up to 66: each send's route re-attempts and the retries of requests the provider said it did not process (unprocessedRetries), at most (10 + 1) x (5 + 1); a record with more than 10 names model-answer@1.1.

sends.description: How many times the call was sent: 1, or 2 when a restart sent it once more.

attempts.description: Provider requests the last send took, its transient re-attempts and the retries of requests the provider said it did not process included. Each may be billed; usage counts only the one that answered. At most 10 in @1.0; @1.1 allows 66, the combined bounds' worst case per send: (unprocessedRetries + 1) × (maxRetries + 1) = 11 × 6.

then.description: More than 10 attempts are refused before @1.1.
